data_section_full_text:
3.1 Data sources


Our primary dataset consists of analyst earnings forecasts, corporate traded debt
pricing and financial information. The data covers the period from 1984 through
2004. Financial information is compiled from Compustat, analyst information from
the Institutional Broker Estimate System (I/B/E/S) annual consensus earnings
forecast, and traded corporate debt pricing from the Lehman Brothers Fixed Income
(LBFI) database.

For a firm-year observation to be included in the analyses, analyst data must
be available in I/B/E/S based on consensus earnings per share; bond data must be
available in the Lehman Brothers database; and firm financial information must be
available from the Compustat database. We exclude bonds with ‘‘matrix’’ based
quotes from our analysis as well as financial and regulated firms. The final data set is
comprised of 6,075 firm-year observations for 904 firms.
